set_aside_reason: OTHER: Serious-adverse-event counts are reported, but no confidence interval for their between-arm effect is stated in any held source.

population.span: we enrolled adults (≥18 years of age) with severe Covid-19 pneumonia, as confirmed by positive polymerase-chain-reaction (PCR) assay of any body fluid and evidenced by bilateral chest infiltrates on chest radiography or computed tomography.

estimate.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred in 103 of 295 patients (34.9%) in the tocilizumab group and in 55 of 143 patients (38.5%) in the placebo group.

analysis_set.span: Safety was assessed in the population that included all the patients who had received a dose of tocilizumab or placebo, according to the trial agent that was first received. Patients who received either tocilizumab or placebo in error were included in the safety analysis.

treatment_strategy.span: Eligible patients were randomly assigned in a 2:1 ratio to receive a single intravenous infusion of tocilizumab (at a dose of 8 mg per kilogram of body weight, with a maximum dose of 800 mg) or placebo plus standard care by means of an interactive voice or Web-based response system and permuted-block randomization.

follow_up.span: In the safety population, adverse events were reported in 77.3% of 295 patients in the tocilizumab group and in 81.1% of 143 patients in the placebo group through day 28 (<xref rid="t3" ref-type="table">Table 3</xref>); serious adverse events were reported in 34.9% and 38.5%, respectively.

absent_reason: ci: No confidence interval for the serious-adverse-event between-arm effect is reported in any supplied source; none was calculated.
served_mismatch: The served counts match serious adverse events, but the served analysis_set 'modified intention-to-treat' is incorrect. These counts use the safety population grouped by first treatment received. No source-reported OR or corresponding CI is available.

candidate_rejections.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred in 103 of 295 patients (34.9%) in the tocilizumab group and in 55 of 143 patients (38.5%) in the placebo group.
candidate_rejections.why: Reject the served attribution of these counts to modified intention-to-treat; retain the counts with their explicitly stated safety analysis population.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The trial enrolled adults with severe COVID-19 pneumonia who were hospitalized, within the question's population.
entry_population_matches_question.span: In this phase 3 trial, we randomly assigned patients who were hospitalized with severe Covid-19 pneumonia

notes: Extraction targets the served serious-adverse-events outcome. Counts denote patients with at least one event. The protocol allowed a second infusion 8 to 24 hours after the first if clinical signs or symptoms did not improve or worsened. All spans use the held full-text source; the count sentence appears in its abstract.
